newsitems.title: Авторы War Thunder показали возможности NVIDIA DLSS 5 - технология преобразит освещение и детали окружения
newsitems.contents: Разработчики War Thunder продемонстрировали, как NVIDIA DLSS 5 изменит изображение в игре. В представленном материале особое внимание уделили освещению, отражениям и детализации материалов: новая технология должна сделать сцены заметно реалистичнее, особенно во время дождя и в пасмурную погоду. DLSS 5 появится в игре с выходом крупного обновления «Тень орла». В основе технологии лежит 3D-Guided Neural Rendering — нейросетевой метод обработки изображения, который анализирует отрисованный кадр вместе с данными о цвете, глубине сцены и движении объектов. На их основе искусственный интеллект в реальном времени корректирует освещение, затенение и свойства материалов, стараясь сохранить исходную геометрию и художественный замысел разработчиков. Судя по описанию авторов, особенно заметные изменения коснутся мягкого рассеянного света, мокрых поверхностей и небольших деталей окружения. При этом DLSS 5 должна не только улучшить визуальную составляющую, но и обеспечить высокую частоту кадров даже...

newsitems.title: War Thunder получит DLSS 5 в ноябре - NVIDIA обещает до 400 FPS в 4K с Ray Reconstruction и 6X Multi Frame Generation
newsitems.contents: NVIDIA подтвердила, что War Thunder получит DLSS 5 с технологией 3D-Guided Neural Rendering в середине ноября вместе с обновлением Eagle’s Shadow от Gaijin Entertainment. Новая технология должна улучшить освещение, тени и детализацию материалов техники и окружения. Компания заявляет о производительности до 400 FPS в разрешении 4K при использовании Ray Reconstruction и 6X Multi Frame Generation. В отличие от Super Resolution, DLSS 5 использует ИИ для улучшения освещения и внешнего вида материалов, включая блики, тени и микроконтраст. Показатель 400 FPS получен NVIDIA в наземном сражении и включает кадры, созданные ИИ, поэтому не отражает нативную производительность рендеринга. Eagle’s Shadow также добавит новые самолёты, танки и корабли, включая F-15EX Eagle II, кассетные бомбы и визуальные улучшения. Точная дата выхода обновления пока не объявлена. newsitems.author: Blitzkrieg Wulf
newsitems.contents: Hey everyone! That’s right, cluster bombs are coming to War Thunder Air Battles! In today’s dev blog, we’ll go over what they are and what they’re used for. Let’s dive in!So, what exactly are cluster bombs? They are a specific type of munition designed to engage multiple targets over a large area. Rather than being a single large bomb, they act as a container that disperses a number of submunitions across an extensive area. A cluster bomb is released from an aircraft just like any conventional munition, then at a predetermined altitude, a fuze triggers, and the submunitions are propelled outward, covering a wide area on the ground. When you’re using cluster bombs against concentrations of lightly armored or unarmored vehicles, this weapon achieves an effect that a conventional bomb of the same weight simply cannot match.In Air Battles and Nuclear Escalation, cluster bombs can be especially good against AI-controlled vehicles, where they are concentrated around key bases. newsitems.title: Improvements to DIRCM
newsitems.author: Blitzkrieg Wulf
newsitems.contents: The missile used to know where it was at all times, then it took a laser in the seeker!In the upcoming major update, we’ll be releasing an overhauled version of DIRCM that addresses several shortcomings.In the game, all DIRCM currently function similarly to regular IRCM with very wide radiation sectors. This means that the jammer is always active and emitting as long as the player has IRCM enabled. It works in a fixed sector around the carrying vehicle regardless of where the threat is, and it works on many threats simultaneously.In reality, DIRCM is directional for a reason. To provide a high-powered jamming signal, it focuses the signal within a narrow field of effect, which is then directed towards threats. This applies to both lamp-based and laser-based jammers.The new implementation works the same way: turret mechanics direct a narrow jamming signal at the threat. newsitems.title: Improvements to the Controls for CCRP Bombing!
newsitems.author: Blitzkrieg Wulf
newsitems.contents: CCRP Bombing, now simple and easy to understand!In the upcoming major update, we’ve reworked the controls for CCRP (Constantly Computed Release Point) bombing. The previous mechanic was sufficient when CCRP was a niche tool used by only the most experienced pilots. However with the introduction of Nuclear Escalation, using the automated system to drop nuclear bombs, CCRP has become the primary method for delivering a nuclear strike. The old interface however does have some drawbacks. We’ve redesigned the system so that it no longer interferes with standard bomb dropping or clutters half the screen.What were the current drawbacks? The bomb-release button was used for both CCRP and manual release, causing the two functions to conflict. Once CCRP bombing mode was enabled, it was no longer possible to drop a bomb manually. newsitems.contents: We’re working on regenerative steering for tanks and want to hear your opinion!Hey everyone! As you may have noticed, we’ve launched limited testing of a new control mechanic for tracked vehicles on the Dev server. Specifically, regenerative steering! Currently, this mechanic is implemented for the Leopard 2 families, along with the Type 10 and Type 90 series of tanks.What is Regenerative Steering?So, what exactly is it and how does it work? Currently, most tanks in the game turn by disengaging the clutch and braking the inner track, essentially locking one side of the chassis, causing a loss of speed and power. Regenerative steering preserves power by redistributing it between the tracks: one speeds up while the other slows down. newsitems.title: Work-In-Progress: The M7 Tank
newsitems.author: Blitzkrieg Wulf
newsitems.contents: Today we’re very pleased to share a new work in progress vehicle with you, currently being crafted by War Thunder artists. This is the American M7 medium tank, a project developed right alongside the Sherman.Initially the M7 project was conceived as a light tank, intended to replace the M3 Stuart. As development progressed however, the growing list of requirements led to a significant increase in the vehicle’s weight, pushing it over the threshold for a light tank. Ultimately, its combat characteristics became nearly identical to the M4 Sherman. As the Sherman was already comfortably rolling off the assembly lines, mass production of the M7 was deemed impractical.Let’s have a look at the new model. At a glance, you might see echoes of several different tanks. You may notice the low, rounded silhouette of the M22, the cast hull lines reminiscent of the Canadian Ram, or a transmission plate that shares elements of the Lee and Sherman. newsitems.contents: The confrontation between North and South Korea that began in 1950 quickly escalated into a large-scale conflict, with the USSR and China supporting one side, and the USA, Great Britain, and several other nations backing the other. The war marked the first time jet aircraft were used on a massive scale. American B-29 Superfortress bombers dominated the Korean skies, but soon they met a new challenge: Soviet MiG-15 fighter jets!On April 12nd 1951, B-29 bombers escorted by American fighters headed toward northwestern North Korea but were intercepted by Soviet MiG-15s. Casualty figures vary, but the victory belonged entirely to the USSR, with Soviet pilots managing to shoot down several bombers and fighters with no or minimal losses of their own. newsitems.title: Discounts for P.O. Sukhoi’s Birthday!
newsitems.author: War Thunder Commander
newsitems.contents: Pavel Osipovich Sukhoi was born on July 22nd 1895. In the early 1910s, while a student in Gomel, he witnessed a flight by the famous aviator Sergei Utochkin; he loved it so much that he decided to dedicate his life to aircraft design. During the 1920s and 1930s, he worked under the supervision of Andrei Tupolev, and after developing the BB-1 bomber, he was given his own design bureau. The BB-1 — designated the Su-2 — saw extensive use during the early stages of the Second World War.
